name: Block-Confidence Normalized Rate Preconditioner
parent_evidence: CNDRP step800 PSNR delta=-0.004515 with 4/6 positive domains
CNDRP step800 SSIM delta=-0.017178 and worst-domain delta=-1.616276
CNDRP coordinate minimum scales approached 1e-6 with relative gradient changes up to 0.97
unsb_object: native generator gradient under a parameter-block DT sensitivity confidence metric
mathematical_update: For each generator parameter tensor block b, form two independent dispersion sensitivities a1_b,a2_b, signal s_b=||(a1_b+a2_b)/2||^2 and variation v_b=||a1_b-a2_b||^2/2. Use the scalar p_b=(v_b+eps_b)/(s_b+v_b+eps_b) and g_new,b=p_b*g0,b.
derivation: CNDRP's elementwise metric can change convolutional filter direction even though every coordinate scale is positive.
A single positive scalar per parameter block preserves every within-block gradient angle exactly while retaining the confidence-normalized DT rate interpretation.
For any positive diagonal Adam metric M, <g0,p_b g0>_M=p_b||g0||_M^2>0 for a nonzero block, so native descent and stationary points are preserved.
A reproducible sensitivity signal slows only the affected block; replicate disagreement returns p_b toward one without a threshold.
The objective, endpoint law, data measure and inference path remain exactly native UNSB.
long_horizon_property: strictly positive block preconditioning preserves native stationary points and cannot reverse a native descent direction
identity_condition: the block's mean DT sensitivity is zero or dominated by independent-replicate variation
self_null_condition: DT dispersion sensitivity is absent or statistically irreproducible in the current state
unbiased_or_invariance_property: native objective, endpoint law and within-block gradient directions are invariant
paired_target_proof: both sensitivity replicates use only unpaired bridge states and isolated generator latents
expected_valid_states: states where DT sensitivity is reproducible at network-block scale but coordinate estimates are too noisy
falsification_test: close the CNDRP/BCNRP mechanism after this generation if block-direction invariance, exact zero intervention or resume fails, or if its 400/800 micro trajectory is late-negative or still violates structure guardrails
compute_cost: two antithetic sensitivity backwards plus the native generator backward
memory_cost: two sensitivity gradients and one native gradient
allowed_claim: tests whether DT's near-tie can become a structurally safe long-horizon metric at functional block resolution
forbidden_claims: route1 is exhausted if this candidate fails
